svg.title: Figure31 Authorization Invalidation and Fail-Closed Propagation
svg.desc: NEW-shot2play Protocol Suite Version 2.0. A previously valid authorization becomes invalid or restricted. The invalidation propagates through the decision lineage and downstream enforcement state. Protected execution is fail-closed unless a new valid authorization basis is established through controlled recovery.
svg.text: Figure31 Authorization Invalidation and Fail-Closed Propagation
Invalidation · Propagation · Enforcement · Fail-Closed · Controlled Recovery
A previously valid authorization SHALL NOT remain effective after its authoritative security basis becomes invalid or restricted.
UNKNOWN OR UNRESOLVED AUTHORIZATION SHALL NOT BE INTERPRETED AS ALLOW.
Dependent execution paths SHALL be restricted, invalidated, re-evaluated, or blocked.
